subject: Eval sprint — success metrics & owner roster
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire@nebulacorp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps from today — eval scope and critical metrics

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a request:

Summary
- Nebula wants to validate Redwood for high-throughput routing of semantically-enriched search over 3M records.
- Primary concerns: 1) latency under live-ish load, 2) end-to-end accuracy against our current reranker, 3) telemetry for token-level cost and per-request tracing.

Asks we need from Redwood to scope the validation sprint
1) Proposed success criteria (latency targets, recall/precision delta allowed, SLA to measure)
2) A short evaluation plan with milestones and ownership (who on Redwood will own infra, app integration, security questionnaire, procurement)
3) Rough timeline and any pre-reqs for test data and credentials (we can share a masked sample)

Attaching Nebula_Eval_Template.xlsx with our suggested metrics and sample datasets. Please put together a one-page gameplan and owners by EOD today if possible — procurement expects a kickoff calendar next week.

Claire Dunn
Head of Data Products, Nebula Corp
claire@nebulacorp.com

Attachment: Nebula_Eval_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet with evaluation metrics and sample file list)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Claire Dunn <claire@nebulacorp.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps from today — eval scope and critical metrics

Claire — thanks for the clear brief and the template. Below is a concise evaluation "gameplan" we can commit to and the Redwood stewards for each lane.

One-page gameplan (high level)
- Objective: Validate Redwood’s ability to meet Nebula latency and relevance SLAs in a 2-week validation window with a staged ramp to 100 RPS.
- Validation windows: Week 1 (integration + smoke), Week 2 (load + regression + obs).
- Success criteria (pass if all three):
  • p95 latency (end-to-end) < 220ms for 768-token prompts under 50 RPS staging;
  • Relevance delta: < 5% degradation on top-10 recall vs Nebula baseline;
  • Observability: token-level cost breakdown and distributed trace for >= 90% of requests in the window.

Redwood stewards (RACI-lite)
- Infra (R): karthik_iyer — will provision dedicated test pool, configure batching and KV cache sizing, and run load scripts.
- App/integration (A): ben_carter — will own SDK integration, prompt templates, and the end-to-end eval harness.
- Security/privacy liaison (C): soojin_lee — will shepherd the security questionnaire, data-masking needs, and audit log access.
- Procurement contact (I): Claire -> procurement@nebulacorp.com (we'll keep your procurement looped for quoting/contract path).

Pre-reqs from Nebula
- Masked sample dataset (up to 20k records) and an example query distribution CSV
- Account-level IP allowlist for our test pool (if you want the pool locked)
- Contact for procurement and SOC/infosec exchanges (Procurement + Security point)

Suggested timeline (proposed kickoff next Tue):
- Day 0 (Kickoff): confirm dataset, sign short SOW/quote, exchange test creds
- Days 1–3: integration, smoke tests, security checklist
- Days 4–10: ramped load & metrics capture, regression checks
- Day 11: preliminary readout and decision checkpoint

Attachments from Redwood: redwood-eval-sla.md (short doc outlining our validation SLOs and expected logs) — attaching separately.

Ask: Ben / Karthik — can you both confirm you have capacity to start on Tue and flag any blockers? Claire — does the proposed pass/fail criteria line up with your procurement needs?

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Claire Dunn <claire@nebulacorp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps from today — eval scope and critical metrics

I can take the app/integration lane. Quick notes and one open question: 

Notes
- I'll stub the eval harness against the sample dataset format in Claire's spreadsheet; plan to keep prompts and reranking logic in a small repo we can share.
- For pass/fail I agree with the thresholds but suggest we add a scoped regression check on top-k precision (top-3) as a risk signal.

Open question
- Data handoff: Claire, can you confirm when the masked sample will be available and whether it will include any session-level context (user history)? That will affect prompt engineering.

Attachment: redwood-eval-sla.md (short SLO and logging expectations)

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Claire Dunn <claire@nebulacorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps from today — infra notes and capacity plan

Thanks — note from infra side with concrete asks and a short checklist.

Infra plan (K):
- Provision one dedicated GPU test pool with the following baseline: 2x A100 equivalent, 32GB KV cache, network egress routing via us-west region.
- Kernel & quantization: we'll test FP16 + 4-bit quantized variant for the workload; expect ~25–35% cost reduction in tokens.
- Load script & ramp: I will run a scripted ramp to 100 RPS across Day 4–7 and capture p50/p95/p99.

Checklist for Nebula (what I need from your ops contact)
- Temporary IP allowlist and short-lived credentials for the test pool (we can use scoped API key + IP restriction)
- Representative request-rate CSV (hourly distribution) so we can shape batches correctly
- A shared Slack channel or Pager for the run window (helps surface infra alerts quickly)

Estimate: we can have infra standing by within 48 hours of kickoff sign-off. If Nebula wants a hardened VPC test, that adds ~3 business days for networking + IAM changes.

I'll block time Friday to prepare the load harness — Ben, want me to include a simple script to replay query traces into the eval harness?

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karhtik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Claire Dunn <claire@nebulacorp.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps from today — confirm kickoff & procurement

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clarity. Procurement is looped in (procurement@nebulacorp.com). A couple of quick confirmations and the go-ahead: 

Confirmations from Nebula
- We can provide masked sample dataset by EOD Monday and a user-history flag column (no PII).
- Ops will supply an IP allowlist and an ops contact for the replay by Monday morning.
- Procurement expects a short SOW and quote; Claire M. (procurement) will review the redlined terms — she prefers a standard proof-of-concept agreement.

Next steps agreed
1) Redwood to send short SOW + quote and the one-page gameplan (Soojin) by EOD today.
2) Ben to share the eval harness repo link and a readme for data format.
3) Karthik to provision a test pool within 48 hours of SOW sign-off (or 3 business days if Nebula requires VPC).
4) Kickoff call: Tue 2026-12-15 09:00 PT — Claire, please confirm.

I'll confirm kickoff after we receive the SOW and the masked dataset. Thanks all — excited to get this moving.

— Claire
